# Lucide icons

Six unmodified outline icons from [Lucide](https://lucide.dev) (ISC licence, see LICENSE),
pinned to commit `1ef60af944de207e0d5176905a0759ba12e6ee8d`. They draw the header
navigation and the Shortlist button. `manifest.json` records each file's source URL,
SHA-256 and size.

Icons are painted with a CSS mask (see `.msi` in `web/ui.css`), so `currentColor` sets their colour.
